findings.message: This hook calls NetworkService but its name does not end in Request. The suffix is what makes a network call visible at the import site: a caller reading `useUser()` cannot tell it reaches the server, and so cannot know it needs loading and error handling until the hook is already wired in. Rename it to end in Request.

This file declares a hook that calls NetworkService, but the file name does not end in Request. The name is the only signal a grep or a file tree gives, so a network module that does not carry the suffix is invisible to anyone auditing what talks to the server. Rename the file to end in Request.
